Waiting at Superchargers is rare, but when it happens, customers should be able to plan with confidence. Superchargers are the only fast chargers with predictive wait times and we're now using vehicle trajectory data to improve these predictions.

Not all customers use Trip Planner to navigate to Superchargers, and amenities nearby also make forecasts harder (ex: cars queuing in a drive through next to a Supercharger). Hence, we've had instances where estimations were off, including at the Diner, where actual waits were longer than shown. This new model is much better, will keep improving, and is now being deployed at Superchargers globally.

Yesterday, @TSLA_inside_ and myself took a ride with FSD in Eindhoven! 🚗💨 
I was super excited to finally experience it firsthand, I’ve been waiting for it for so long..

The most impressive moment? FSD spotted a car parked halfway on the road. The car checked the blind spot just like a human driver, waited for a safe gap, and maneuvered around it smoothly. Zero stress, pure intelligence! 🤖
It was also very cool to feel how the Tesla reacted to a pedestrian still further away that was going to cross the street, and also check out how the Tesla reacted to bikers that were crossing the street. Amazing!

A huge thank you to @elonmusk and the @Tesla team for letting us make this start in the Netherlands. 🇳🇱 Now let’s hope the rest of Europe follows soon, because this is the future of road safety! 🌍⚡️
Enjoy the video!
